title: Rack A-2 sample check
notes: Every step can be completed manually (button), by voice ("mark step complete") or with a thumbs-up gesture. Steps with an `auto` rule also complete by themselves when the live detection rule holds for `seconds`.

steps.title: Crew in position
steps.instruction: Face the camera with your head and shoulders in view
steps.instructionHi: कैमरे की ओर मुँह करें, सिर और कंधे दिखें

steps.title: Hands ready
steps.instruction: Show both open hands to the camera
steps.instructionHi: दोनों खुले हाथ कैमरे को दिखाएँ

steps.title: Retrieve sample container
steps.instruction: Hold the sample bottle in view of the camera
steps.instructionHi: नमूने की बोतल कैमरे के सामने रखें

steps.title: Inspect sample
steps.instruction: Inspect the sample, then give a thumbs up
steps.instructionHi: नमूना जाँचें, फिर अंगूठा ऊपर करें

steps.title: Stow and confirm
steps.instruction: Stow the sample and confirm the step
steps.instructionHi: नमूना रखें और चरण की पुष्टि करें
